title: Your Name.
overview: A high-school boy in Tokyo and a girl in a mountain town start waking up in each other's bodies. As they leave notes for each other, they discover the link between them is tied to a comet and a disaster.
review: Gorgeous skies, and a twist that hits harder than it has any right to.
notes: Twilight ("kataware-doki") as the moment two worlds overlap — lovely idea.
